constraints: Quorum and failure behavior must be proven before runtime

nonnegotiable_invariants.rule: Root and consumed-claim ledger must be in independently administered and restored domain; product/tenant/API identity cannot reset, restore or replace it.

Authority claim-consume is linearizable durable CAS and bound to full tenant/company/environment/project/plan/task/run/principal/intent/transaction/request/version/issuer/policy_epoch/root_epoch and stable effect_id; retry cannot erase consumption.
Claim consumption durably precedes any protected business T1 attempt; failure or lost reply after consumption is quarantined with no automatic replay.
Separate effect sink validates independent current root/epoch and monotonically fenced fresh proof at acceptance time, and atomically deduplicates effect_id in its own domain.
Revocation, key rotation, lease expiry, root regression and stale replicas deny acceptance; historical signed pins/receipts are never authority.
Unknown COMMIT outcome uses exact authority/sink/outbox reconciliation, does not make new claim or retry blindly; no bypass on partition or timeouts.
No direct effect endpoint without server-enforced full mediation and distinct effect credentials; all tenant/run scope mismatches reject.
Root backup restore must prove monotonic continuity from independently held checkpoint; original D03-D04 eight independent acceptance cases must be independently executed.
